title: S 级核心词 · 第 49 组
objectives: 认识并会读这 20 个高频词：点 🔊 音标听发音，跟读一遍
记住每个词的**中文意思**和**英文释义**，并用近义词、反义词把意思连成一片
在例句短文里认出这些词，体会它们在句子里的语气（褒、贬、中性）

items.en: to teach someone to accept a set of beliefs without question

items.zh: 辱骂的；臭名昭著的，令人鄙视的
items.en: expressing scorn; deserving of disgrace
not aware of what is happening around one
a formal statement given as evidence; proof
an excessive amount; to overfill

blocks.text: The cult sought to [[indoctrinate]] the young with [[opprobrious]] slogans; the [[oblivious]] members gave [[testimony]] that showed a [[surfeit]] of blind loyalty.

items.en: bad-tempered and difficult to deal with
a sudden, complete failure or collapse
the outer edge; not part of the mainstream
to perceive or recognize with effort

items.zh: 挑剔的，极仔细的，追求完美的
items.en: very attentive to detail and hard to please

blocks.text: The [[cantankerous]] host faced a [[debacle]] when guests from the [[fringe]] arrived; he could not [[discern]] which were friends, and the [[fastidious]] cook walked out.

gloss.fastidious: 挑剔的，极仔细的，追求完美的

items.zh: 相对平静时期，间隙；使镇静，使安心
items.en: a temporary period of calm; to soothe or deceive into calm
to decrease gradually in strength or size
to pull away by force or effort
unlikely and hard to believe
the disclosing of something previously hidden

blocks.text: After a brief [[lull]], the storm began to [[wane]]; sailors had to [[wrest]] the helm back, and the [[far-fetched]] tale of a sea beast was the biggest [[revelation]] of the trip.

items.en: a clever maneuver to gain an advantage
real, not copied or fake
to speak of someone in an abusively bad way
a speech or writing of glowing praise
to make known something private or secret

blocks.text: The reporter's [[ploy]] was to feign an [[authentic]] interest; she would [[vilify]] no one, but wrote an [[encomium]] to the clerk who agreed to [[divulge]] the facts.

options: 挑剔的，极仔细的，追求完美的
辱骂的；臭名昭著的，令人鄙视的
questions.explain: oblivious：不知道的，不知情的（not aware of what is happening around one）。近义词：unaware, heedless。
wrest：辛苦地获得（to pull away by force or effort）。近义词：wring, extract。

questions.q: 哪个词的意思是「赞颂之词」？
questions.explain: encomium：赞颂之词（a speech or writing of glowing praise）。

questions.q: 哪个词和 **malign** 的意思最接近？
questions.explain: vilify 与 malign 近义：to speak of someone in an abusively bad way。

questions.q:
选最适合填入空格的词：

> The reporter's ploy was to feign an authentic interest; she would vilify no one, but wrote an ____ to the clerk who agreed to divulge the facts.
questions.explain: encomium：赞颂之词（a speech or writing of glowing praise）。
